quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **105:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Açılış, Allah’ın adını merhamet ve rahmet sıfatlarıyla yükselterek bütün sahneyi okunur hâle getiren bir eşik kurar. Sonraki ayetlerdeki görme çağrısı, taşla sınır koyma ve yenmiş ekin çöpüne dönüşme imgesi bu merhameti yalnız yumuşaklık değil, koruyucu sınır ve hayatı parçalanmadan tutan rahmet olarak değiştirir. {س م و B005; س م و B001; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B002; ر ح م B003; ح ج ر B001; ح ج ر B005; ء ك ل B006}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Açılış, Allah’ın adını merhamet ve rahmet sıfatlarıyla yükselterek bütün sahneyi okunur hâle getiren bir eşik kurar. Sonraki ayetlerdeki görme çağrısı, taşla sınır koyma ve yenmiş ekin çöpüne dönüşme imgesi bu merhameti yalnız yumuşaklık değil, koruyucu sınır ve hayatı parçalanmadan tutan rahmet olarak değiştirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **105:1.** أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, fil sahiplerine ne yapıldığını hatırlatmaktan çok, Rabbin fiilinin nasıl işlediğini görmeye çağırır. Sonraki جعل tekrarları, kuş sürüleri ve taş atışı bu fiili tek bir darbeden çıkarıp planı saptıran, güç düzenini tersine çeviren ve ağır fil topluluğunu hafif ama düzenli göksel güç karşısında çözen bir mekanizmaya dönüştürür. {ر ء ي B001; ر ء ي B012; ر ء ي B013; ف ع ل B001; ر ب ب B001; ر ب ب B002; ص ح ب B001; ص ح ب B004; ف ي ل B004; ف ي ل B001; ط ي ر B001; ء ب ل B003; ر م ي B001; ح ج ر B003}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, fil sahiplerine ne yapıldığını hatırlatmaktan çok, Rabbin fiilinin nasıl işlediğini görmeye çağırır. Sonraki جعل tekrarları, kuş sürüleri ve taş atışı bu fiili tek bir darbeden çıkarıp planı saptıran, güç düzenini tersine çeviren ve ağır fil topluluğunu hafif ama düzenli göksel güç karşısında çözen bir mekanizmaya dönüştürür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **105:2.** أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, onların hilesinin yalnız engellendiğini değil, hilenin kendi hedefini kaybeden bir sapma alanına sokulduğunu söyler. Kuşların dağınık ve ardışık gelişi ile son ayetteki ikinci جعل, bu sapmayı önce niyetin içindeki yön kaybı, sonra da hile sahiplerinin maddi çözülüşü olarak gösterir. {ج ع ل B002; ك ي د B001; ك ي د B002; ك ي د B004; ض ل ل B001; ض ل ل B002; ض ل ل B003; ض ل ل B005; ر س ل B005; ء ب ل B003; ع ص ف B001; ء ك ل B006}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, onların hilesinin yalnız engellendiğini değil, hilenin kendi hedefini kaybeden bir sapma alanına sokulduğunu söyler. Kuşların dağınık ve ardışık gelişi ile son ayetteki ikinci جعل, bu sapmayı önce niyetin içindeki yön kaybı, sonra da hile sahiplerinin maddi çözülüşü olarak gösterir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **105:3.** وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, üzerlerine kuşların gönderilmesini kontrollü bir salıverme ve dalga dalga sevk olarak okutur. Sonraki سجيل taşları ve son chaff imgesi, bu kuşları yalnız canlılar değil; mesaj taşıyan, hükmü görünür kılan, ağır fil arkadaşlığına karşı dağınık fakat düzenli bir gök-sürüsü gibi çalışan aracılar hâline getirir. {ر س ل B001; ر س ل B002; ر س ل B005; ط ي ر B001; ط ي ر B002; ء ب ل B001; ء ب ل B003; س ج ل B004; ع ص ف B002; ع ص ف B004}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, üzerlerine kuşların gönderilmesini kontrollü bir salıverme ve dalga dalga sevk olarak okutur. Sonraki سجيل taşları ve son chaff imgesi, bu kuşları yalnız canlılar değil; mesaj taşıyan, hükmü görünür kılan, ağır fil arkadaşlığına karşı dağınık fakat düzenli bir gök-sürüsü gibi çalışan aracılar hâline getirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **105:4.** تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, kuşların onları sert taşlarla vurmasını fiziksel bir atış olarak verir. سجيل’in dolu kova, taşan akış ve kayıt anlam alanlarıyla حَجَر’in sınır ve engel alanı birleşince bu atış, gökten inen taş yağmuru, geçilemeyen bir sınır ve görünür bir hüküm kaydı hâline gelir. {ر م ي B001; ر م ي B004; ر م ي B008; ح ج ر B001; ح ج ر B003; ح ج ر B004; ح ج ر B005; س ج ل B001; س ج ل B003; س ج ل B004; ر س ل B002}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **105:5.** فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, onları yenmiş kuru ekin artığına çevrilmiş son bir hâl olarak gösterir. Önceki hile, kuşların havadaki dağılışı ve taşların inişi bu sonucu yalnız yok oluş değil; ağır ve sahiplenici bir güç topluluğunun fırtınayla savrulmuş, tüketilmiş ve kendi çabasından değersiz artık üretmiş bir bedene dönüşmesi olarak değiştirir. {ج ع ل B002; ع ص ف B001; ع ص ف B002; ع ص ف B004; ع ص ف B005; ء ك ل B001; ء ك ل B006; ء ك ل B007; ص ح ب B001; ف ي ل B004; ك ي د B002}

parent_channels.name: Directed Agency and Effected Change

subchannels.name: Making and State Transformation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor produces an entity, associates its parts, and renders it into a new condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: enacted work `ف ع ل:B001/m01`; creation `ج ع ل:B001/m01`; state conversion `ج ع ل:B002/m01`; making one thing accompany another `ص ح ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Work becomes causation when making both brings something about and fixes it into a new relation or condition.

subchannels.name: Dispatch and Projectile Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A released carrier crosses space and delivers a projected object to a target.
subchannels.active_motifs: sending and release `ر س ل:B001/m01`; throwing `ر م ي:B001/m01`; airborne movement `ط ي ر:B001/m01`; solid projectile `ح ج ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 105:3 أَرْسَلَ and طَيْرًا; 105:4 تَرْمِي and حِجَارَةٍ
subchannels.synthesis: Release, flight, throwing, and stone join as successive roles in one directed delivery mechanism.

subchannels.name: Sustained Exertion to an Endpoint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A difficult operation is begun, maintained, and driven until it reaches a terminal state.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning and persisting `ج ع ل:B004/m01`; strenuous handling `ك ي د:B001/m01`; enacted operation `ف ع ل:B001/m01`; movement to an endpoint `ر م ي:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The action is not a momentary impulse but an effortful process whose continuation matters because it carries the object to a definite outcome.

subchannels.name: Targeted Impact and Terminal Reduction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A massive animal host is struck with hard projectiles and converted into crushed, consumed remnants.
subchannels.active_motifs: elephant `ف ي ل:B004/m01`; stone hardness `ح ج ر:B003/m01`; projected strike `ر م ي:B001/m01`; crushing to chaff `ع ص ف:B004/m02`; state conversion `ج ع ل:B002/m01`; consumed object `ء ك ل:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene closes the causal chain by joining target, missile, impact, fragmentation, and the final condition of something already eaten through.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An initiating actor carries an intention through making, release, directed movement, and a resulting change of state.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:1 فَعَلَ, 105:2 يَجْعَلْ, 105:3 أَرْسَلَ, 105:4 تَرْمِي, and 105:5 جَعَلَ enact the sequence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same pattern extends from overt dispatch into craft, sustained handling, attachment, and terminal material transformation.

parent_channels.name: Perception, Demonstration, and Judgment

subchannels.name: Witnessing, Showing, and Calling Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: A viewer is alerted, an object is made visible, and perception becomes shared knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory seeing `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; demonstrative showing `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; attention-seeking inquiry `ر ء ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing is organized as a discourse act: attention is summoned, the event is presented, and the addressee is positioned as a witness.

subchannels.name: Deliberation Before Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person slows action, turns a matter over, and reaches a considered opinion.
subchannels.active_motifs: reflective opinion `ر ء ي:B002/m01`; measured deliberateness `ر س ل:B004/m01`; restraining intellect `ح ج ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Thought, measured pacing, and an intellect that blocks impropriety form a controlled judgment process.

subchannels.name: Misjudgment, Conjecture, and Lost Recall
subchannels.scene_or_process: Weak discernment produces an unverified conclusion while memory fails to retain the matter.
subchannels.active_motifs: weak judgment `ف ي ل:B001/m01`; inaccurate conjecture `ر م ي:B009/m01`; lost memory `ض ل ل:B004/m01`; fabricated account `ف ع ل:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Poor discernment moves from guess to invented account, while failed retention removes the corrective memory that could expose the error.

subchannels.name: Framed and Diagnostic Signs
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible mark, frame, or standard lets an observer identify a condition or orientation.
subchannels.active_motifs: mirror and outward appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m01`; raised banner `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; circular halo `ح ج ر:B006/m01`; bodily diagnostic trace `ر ء ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reflection, a raised sign, a ringed outline, and a bodily trace all function as bounded forms that make otherwise hidden information readable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Perception becomes consequential when a sign is noticed, shown, interpreted, and converted into judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:1 تَرَ opens the surah through an appeal to seeing, while 105:2 تَضْلِيلٍ supplies the contrasting possibility of failed judgment or direction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Seeing expands into mirrors, banners, bodily traces, intellectual restraint, and the failure modes of conjecture and memory.

parent_channels.name: Loss, Concealment, and Dispersal

subchannels.name: A Design Diverted from Its Goal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A deliberate scheme is turned away from its intended outcome and made ineffectual.
subchannels.active_motifs: calculated scheme `ك ي د:B002/m01`; deviation from the intended course `ض ل ل:B001/m01`; conversion into a failed state `ج ع ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Intention supplies the route, deviation breaks it, and causative transformation fixes the scheme in failure.

subchannels.name: Burial and Hidden-Object Search
subchannels.scene_or_process: An object is concealed in earth, divided between possible locations, and sought without immediate visibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: disappearance and burial `ض ل ل:B002/m01`; hidden-object game `ف ي ل:B003/m01`; loss of the object's location `ض ل ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment changes a visible object into a location problem, and the search proceeds through uncertainty between hidden alternatives.

subchannels.name: Lost Possession Becoming Dispersed Travel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing leaves its holder, moves toward another region, and spreads until recovery becomes difficult.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss from an owner `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; travel toward a direction `ر م ي:B007/m01`; outward dispersal `ط ي ر:B002/m01`; wind-driven scattering `ع ص ف:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Loss becomes spatial as departure, directional movement, and scattering progressively separate the object from its point of possession.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A thing ceases to reach its intended place by deviating, disappearing, being lost, or scattering into an uncollectable field.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:2 كَيْدَ and تَضْلِيلٍ name a design diverted from its goal, while 105:3 طَيْرًا and 105:5 عَصْفٍ embody distributed movement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Frustrated purpose extends into burial, a hidden-object game, travel, and wind-driven dispersal.

parent_channels.name: Companionship, Care, and Family Continuity

subchannels.name: Attachment and Compatible Association
subchannels.scene_or_process: One entity is made to accompany another and remains with it through compatibility and nurture.
subchannels.active_motifs: attached accompaniment `ص ح ب:B004/m01`; relational making `ج ع ل:B001/m01`; gradual nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; familiar openness `ر س ل:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Association becomes durable when making, nurture, and familiarity turn mere proximity into an accommodating relation.

subchannels.name: Protective Escort and Retained Memory
subchannels.scene_or_process: A companion safeguards a charge and keeps it present rather than allowing it to be forgotten.
subchannels.active_motifs: preservation through accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; continuing companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; lost recall `ض ل ل:B004/m01`; responsible ownership `ر ب ب:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Escort is both spatial and mnemonic: the companion stays beside the charge and prevents it from slipping out of care or remembrance.

subchannels.name: A Child Maturing into a Companion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dependent child is raised within a household until capable of standing beside the elder as a companion.
subchannels.active_motifs: son reaching companionable adulthood `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; stepchild `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; household caretaker `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; nearby shelter `ح ج ر:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Nurture changes the relation itself, carrying a ward from protected dependence into reciprocal companionship.

subchannels.name: Courtship After Household Transition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman whose marriage has ended becomes available to suitors and is assessed through appearance and character.
subchannels.active_motifs: widow or divorcee receiving suitors `ر س ل:B009/m01`; reconfigured stepfamily `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; visible appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m01`; displayed character `ف ع ل:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Family rupture opens a new courtship frame in which household status, visible presentation, and character all become socially legible.

subchannels.name: Need Held in a Protective Lap
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person in need is drawn into close bodily shelter and kept under protective care.
subchannels.active_motifs: lap and embrace `ح ج ر:B005/m01`; close protection `ح ج ر:B005/m02`; need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; safeguarding companionship `ص ح ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Abstract need is spatialized as something gathered into a lap, enclosed at close range, and preserved by an accompanying protector.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A vulnerable person or thing is held in continuity through attachment, accompaniment, nurture, and protective proximity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 105:1 رَبُّ and أَصْحَٰبِ provide the lexical hinges of guardianship and companionship.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Companionship reaches from compatibility between things to memory, stepfamily care, adulthood, widow courtship, and the shelter of a lap.

parent_channels.name: Authority, Covenant, and Public Communication

subchannels.name: Lordship and Protected Following
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sovereign or owner directs a body of companions while assuming responsibility for their order and protection.
subchannels.active_motifs: lordship and mastery `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; organized companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; preservation of companions `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; measured command `ر س ل:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Command is relational rather than solitary, joining mastery to an accompanied body whose continuity depends on ordered care.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Record, and Public Standard
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding agreement is displayed, written, and retained as a publicly recognizable obligation.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; documentary registration `س ج ل:B004/m01`; raised standard `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; carried message `ر س ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The covenant gains social force by moving from pledged relation to visible standard, transmitted wording, and fixed record.

subchannels.name: Messenger and Correspondence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A message is borne between parties, answered through correspondence, and released into public circulation.
subchannels.active_motifs: messenger and message `ر س ل:B002/m01`; correspondence `ر س ل:B008/m01`; unrestrained utterance `س ج ل:B003/m02`; demonstrative presentation `ر ء ي:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Communication forms a relay in which a bearer presents words, parties answer one another, and the utterance is allowed to circulate.

subchannels.name: Learned and Religious Office
subchannels.scene_or_process: A learned or monastic leader occupies an enclosed institution and summons the community by an audible sign.
subchannels.active_motifs: learned authority `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; monk `ء ب ل:B006/m01`; bell-ringer `ء ب ل:B006/m03`; enclosed precinct `ح ج ر:B004/m01`; strained call `ك ي د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Office, place, and signal combine in an institutional scene where knowledge or religious rank is made present through a bounded precinct and a sounded summons.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authority becomes durable through followers, transmitted words, visible standards, covenants, and written records.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 105:1 رَبُّ and أَصْحَٰبِ, 105:3 أَرْسَلَ, and 105:4 سِجِّيلٍ provide the lexical anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sovereignty extends into documentary practice, public signs, scholarly office, monastic leadership, bells, and precincts.

parent_channels.name: Provision, Growth, and Generosity

subchannels.name: Rain Becoming Crop Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain-bearing clouds water young growth until the field yields fruit, grain covering, and fodder.
subchannels.active_motifs: plant-nurturing cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m02`; heavy rainfall `ر م ي:B004/m02`; crop yield `ء ك ل:B002/m01`; young palms `ج ع ل:B006/m01`; grain husk `ع ص ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Water descends, growth is established, and the plant resolves into edible yield and the dry material surrounding it.

subchannels.name: Labor, Wage, and Livelihood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Workers exert themselves, complete a task, receive an agreed payment, and turn it into provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: livelihood-seeking effort `ع ص ف:B005/m01`; payment for work `ج ع ل:B005/m01`; laboring craft `ف ع ل:B003/m01`; allotted provision `ء ك ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Effort becomes livelihood through a social mechanism that joins performed work to stipulated reward and an edible share.

subchannels.name: Meal, Portion, and Hot-Vessel Handling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is portioned, placed in a vessel, handled near heat, and consumed.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating `ء ك ل:B001/m01`; allotted portion `ء ك ل:B003/m01`; eating vessel `ء ك ل:B013/m01`; date portion `ء ب ل:B007/m01`; pot-handling cloth `ج ع ل:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The provision scene moves from measured share to container and heat-safe handling before ending in consumption.

subchannels.name: Willing Gift and Beneficent Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A benefactor acts generously and releases a gift without coercive restriction.
subchannels.active_motifs: generous action `ف ع ل:B002/m01`; willing giving `ر س ل:B010/m02`; free-flowing gift `س ج ل:B003/m01`; blessing `ر ب ب:B016/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Beneficence is pictured as an inward disposition becoming an outward flow that reaches another as unrestricted provision.

subchannels.name: Milk and Thickened Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Milk flows from a full source, is collected, and can be thickened or prepared as food.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing milk `ر س ل:B006/m01`; full udder `س ج ل:B006/m01`; thick syrup or paste `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; food container `ء ك ل:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Bodily abundance becomes provision through flow, collection, and thickening into a stored edible substance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustenance moves from water and growth through labor, harvest, allotment, preparation, and willing distribution.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 105:5 عَصْفٍ and مَّأْكُولٍۭ expose the crop and consumption poles of the channel.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Provision includes wages, young palms, crop yield, date portions, vessels, milk, syrup, free gifts, and blessing.

parent_channels.name: Consuming Force, Fire, and Material Ruin

subchannels.name: Fuel, Delayed Spark, and Ignition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bundled fuel is set before a reluctant spark until fire catches and begins consuming it.
subchannels.active_motifs: firewood bundle `ء ب ل:B005/m01`; fire consuming fuel `ء ك ل:B005/m01`; delayed firestick ignition `ك ي د:B006/m01`; agitated flare `ط ي ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The mechanism joins prepared fuel, frictional delay, sudden agitation, and the self-sustaining appetite of flame.

subchannels.name: Corrosion Through Body and Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Decay enters a bodily or worked surface and progressively eats away its substance.
subchannels.active_motifs: corrosion and bodily irritation `ء ك ل:B006/m01`; hair-bearing hide `ص ح ب:B006/m01`; thickening treatment `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; decay reaching an endpoint `ر م ي:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: A once-protected surface becomes vulnerable to an eating process whose advance is checked by preparation yet tends toward material failure.

subchannels.name: Crushing Force and Devastated Remains
subchannels.scene_or_process: Violent force sweeps through a group, breaks hard bodies, and leaves plant-like fragments.
subchannels.active_motifs: destructive gale or battle `ع ص ف:B004/m01`; pulverization into chaff `ع ص ف:B004/m02`; warfare `ك ي د:B004/m01`; hard stone `ح ج ر:B003/m01`; terminal conversion `ج ع ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 105:2 يَجْعَلْ and كَيْدَ; 105:4 حِجَارَةٍ; 105:5 جَعَلَ and عَصْفٍ
subchannels.synthesis: Whether figured as gale, battle, or impact, the same force crosses a collective body and converts solidity into scattered residue.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A consuming force feeds on material, alters its integrity, and leaves it weakened, corroded, or reduced to remnants.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:5 عَصْفٍ and مَّأْكُولٍۭ present ruin as crop matter already consumed.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Consumption extends into fire fed with bundled wood, delayed ignition, corrosion of bodies and hides, and storm-driven pulverization.

parent_channels.name: Flocks, Herds, and Reproductive Continuity

subchannels.name: Successive Aerial Groups
subchannels.scene_or_process: Birds arrive as separate or successive bands rather than as one undifferentiated mass.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispersed groups `ء ب ل:B003/m01`; successive bands `ء ب ل:B003/m02`; birds in flight `ط ي ر:B001/m01`; one group following another `ر س ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The flock is structured by iteration: airborne bodies retain group boundaries while band follows band across the scene.

subchannels.name: Managed Herd and Stray Animal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A keeper gathers a herd, moves it toward pasture or water, and confronts the risk of an animal becoming ownerless.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel herd and skilled keeping `ء ب ل:B001/m01`; gathered herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; stray animal `ض ل ل:B005/m01`; successive movement to pasture or water `ر س ل:B005/m01`; keeper-companion `ص ح ب:B001/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 105:1 رَبُّ and أَصْحَٰبِ; 105:2 تَضْلِيلٍ; 105:3 أَرْسَلَ and أَبَابِيلَ
subchannels.synthesis: Herding holds multiplicity together through skilled accompaniment, periodic movement, and recovery from dispersal.

subchannels.name: Pastoral Water and Milk Cycle
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animals approach or forgo water, drink from an abundant source, and later yield milk.
subchannels.active_motifs: animal abstention from water `ء ب ل:B002/m01`; recurring milk flow `ر س ل:B006/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; filled water bucket `س ج ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Water access and milk production form a pastoral resource cycle linking thirst, collection, bodily yield, and repeated flow.

subchannels.name: Protected Female, Courtship, and Pregnancy
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected breeding female enters estrus, mates, and shows visible signs of pregnancy or recent birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: animal estrus `ج ع ل:B009/m01`; protected breeding mare `ح ج ر:B007/m01`; visible pregnancy `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; recently delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; sexual abstention `ء ب ل:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Protection, desire, mating, gestation, and fresh maternity form a continuous reproductive sequence.

subchannels.name: Offspring Raised Toward Maturity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young animal or child is nurtured through freshness and dependence toward mature companionship.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich chick `ج ع ل:B010/m01`; fresh youth `ر ب ب:B009/m02`; gradual nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; child reaching companionable age `ص ح ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Juvenile naming, freshness, upbringing, and eventual companionship describe development as a change in both body and social role.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal collectives persist through grouping, movement to resources, protection, breeding, birth, and maturation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:1 فِيلِ and 105:3 طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ place animal bodies and grouped flight in the foreground.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The animal channel expands into camel management, strays, milk and water, protected mares, pregnancy signs, ostrich chicks, and beetles at algae-covered water.

parent_channels.name: Fluid and Airborne Motion

subchannels.name: Light Flight and Smooth Gait
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body moves with lightness, speed, and loose ease across air or ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: flight and aerial lightness `ط ي ر:B001/m01`; swift motion `ع ص ف:B003/m01`; smooth gait `ر س ل:B003/m01`; dust stirred by rapid animals `ع ص ف:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Flight and easy gait share a kinetic profile in which speed, looseness, and stirred air reduce resistance to movement.

subchannels.name: Cloud, Gale, and Pouring Rain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Layered cloud is driven by wind, arrives in thrown-looking pieces, and empties like a filled bucket.
subchannels.active_motifs: layered rain cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; cloud fragments `ر م ي:B004/m01`; filled bucket and pouring `س ج ل:B001/m01`; forceful wind `ع ص ف:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cloud shape, wind-driven motion, and bucket-like discharge combine into one weather mechanism.

subchannels.name: Breath, Gale, and Final Exhalation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Air moves through the lung, intensifies into a blast, and culminates in the strained release of a failing breath.
subchannels.active_motifs: lung `ر ء ي:B009/m01`; gale `ع ص ف:B002/m01`; death struggle `ك ي د:B003/m01`; release and emission `ر س ل:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The scale shifts from bodily respiration to atmospheric blast while preserving the same pressure-and-release process.

subchannels.name: Algae-Covered Abundant Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Standing abundant water acquires a living surface layer that becomes habitat for small creatures.
subchannels.active_motifs: algae covering water `ص ح ب:B007/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; filled water source `س ج ل:B001/m01`; ground beetle `ج ع ل:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Volume, stillness, and surface growth turn water from a mere resource into a layered microhabitat.

subchannels.name: Wide Aperture and Hanging Fullness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A broad-mouthed source gives access to liquid that gathers in a full, hanging container or organ.
subchannels.active_motifs: wide-mouthed well `ط ي ر:B004/m01`; full hanging udder `س ج ل:B006/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; rain-fed filling `ر م ي:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Mouth, depth, fullness, and suspended weight form a shape-and-function analogy between a water source and a bodily reservoir.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Air, breath, cloud, rain, and water are understood through release, lightness, flow, filling, and surface spread.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:3 أَرْسَلَ and طَيْرًا establish airborne release, while 105:4 تَرْمِي and سِجِّيلٍ provide descending and pouring resonances.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Flight reaches smooth gait, clouds become thrown pieces, breath becomes gale, and water becomes an algae-covered habitat or a filled hanging source.

parent_channels.name: Boundaries, Containers, and Held Materials

subchannels.name: Burden Held Under Restriction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A weighty obligation is kept within a prohibition and borne through continued submission.
subchannels.active_motifs: prohibition and restraint `ح ج ر:B001/m01`; burden and liability `ء ب ل:B004/m01`; abiding under a condition `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; submission after resistance `ص ح ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Weight becomes social and legal when a boundary prevents escape and continued obedience keeps the obligation in force.

subchannels.name: Enclosed Precinct and Named Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded site is recognized by its enclosure, place-name, and audible marker.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosed location `ح ج ر:B004/m01`; named place Abla `ء ب ل:B008/m01`; locative designation `ج ع ل:B011/m01`; strained call marking place `ك ي د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Boundary, naming, and signal cooperate to turn undifferentiated space into a socially identifiable precinct.

subchannels.name: Ringed and Sheltered Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: A circular or bodily boundary defines a protected center around an eye, object, or dependent person.
subchannels.active_motifs: circular boundary `ح ج ر:B006/m01`; eye outline `ح ج ر:B006/m02`; sheltered interior `ح ج ر:B005/m02`; visible frame `ر ء ي:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: A ring, outline, and close shelter share the function of separating a valued interior from what lies outside.

subchannels.name: Hot Vessel and Protective Cloth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A heated cooking vessel is lowered or handled with a fitted cloth so that its contents can be served safely.
subchannels.active_motifs: pot-handling cloth `ج ع ل:B007/m01`; food vessel `ء ك ل:B013/m01`; date portion `ء ب ل:B007/m01`; protected handling `ح ج ر:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Container, food, heat, and insulating textile form a compact domestic handling mechanism.

subchannels.name: Quiver, Arrow, and Launched Implement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Short projectiles are gathered in a fitted holder, selected, and released toward a target.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrow container `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; grouped arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; projectile or arrowhead `ر م ي:B003/m01`; short arrow `ر س ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Storage, grouped implements, selection, and launch assemble into a complete projectile kit.

subchannels.name: Sheaf, Bundle, and Dry Plant Matter
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dry stalks and husks are gathered into a compact bundle that can be stored, carried, or fed to fire.
subchannels.active_motifs: firewood bundle `ء ب ل:B005/m01`; dried straw and leaves `ع ص ف:B001/m02`; persistent green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; grain husk `ع ص ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Plant matter moves from living growth to husk and dry fragment, then regains coherence through bundling.

subchannels.name: Prepared Hide Retaining Its Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hide keeps its hair or wool while a thick preparation protects and conditions its surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: hair-bearing hide `ص ح ب:B006/m01`; thick conditioning paste `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; corrosion threatening the surface `ء ك ل:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Retained covering, applied thickener, and resistance to decay form a material-preservation process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A boundary gives material or persons a controlled inside, whether by prohibition, enclosure, wrapping, bundling, or fitted implements.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 105:4 حِجَارَةٍ supplies the root of enclosure and restraint, while 105:5 عَصْفٍ supplies held and fragmented plant matter.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes legal restriction, precincts, body rings, pot cloths, eating vessels, quivers, projectiles, sheaves, and prepared hides.

parent_channels.name: Adversarial Speech, Contest, and Social Harm

subchannels.name: Deceptive Staging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hostile actor fabricates an appearance, draws others into it, and conceals the intended harm.
subchannels.active_motifs: deception and stratagem `ك ي د:B002/m01`; fabricated falsehood `ف ع ل:B004/m01`; ostentatious display `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; constructed state `ج ع ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scheme works by making a false surface whose crafted visibility hides the operation underneath.

subchannels.name: Alternating Contest and Mutual Performance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two sides answer one another in contest, with advantage passing back and forth through matched actions.
subchannels.active_motifs: warfare `ك ي د:B004/m01`; alternating contest `س ج ل:B002/m01`; matched performance `ر س ل:B008/m03`; reciprocal action `ف ع ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Conflict is structured as exchange: each side responds in kind, and temporary ascendancy alternates rather than remaining fixed.

subchannels.name: Accusation and Defamation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker projects an unverified claim onto another person and turns it into reputational injury.
subchannels.active_motifs: verbal accusation `ر م ي:B008/m01`; false claim against another `ء ك ل:B010/m01`; deviation from truth `ض ل ل:B001/m01`; blameworthy conduct `ف ع ل:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech behaves like a projectile: it leaves the accuser, adheres to a target, and consumes social standing through a claim detached from truth.

subchannels.name: Ostentation, Correspondence, and Discord
subchannels.scene_or_process: Public display and circulated messages become instruments for stirring division between people.
subchannels.active_motifs: social ostentation `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; interpersonal corruption `ء ك ل:B009/m01`; correspondence between parties `ر س ل:B008/m01`; altered social standing `ج ع ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reputation is manufactured in public, transmitted between parties, and converted into discord that eats through communal relations.

subchannels.name: Cunning Acquisition and Consumed Wealth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A calculating actor takes another's resources and seeks to secure the gain through social or documentary means.
subchannels.active_motifs: consuming another's wealth `ء ك ل:B004/m01`; cunning livelihood-seeking `ع ص ف:B005/m02`; deceptive contrivance `ك ي د:B002/m01`; documentary fixation of a claim `س ج ل:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Predatory acquisition joins scheme, seizure, and record-making in a process that converts another's substance into the taker's provision.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Opposition is enacted by covert design, alternating contest, accusatory speech, reputational display, and predatory acquisition.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 105:2 كَيْدَ names hostile design, and 105:5 مَّأْكُولٍۭ supplies the image of one party consuming another's substance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Conflict extends from battle into performance, correspondence, false claims, defamation, gossip, ostentation, and seizure of wealth.

parent_channels.name: Disposition, Composure, and Bodily Bearing

subchannels.name: Substance, Intellect, and Weak Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's capacity is measured as either substantial and restraining or lax and prone to faulty judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: material strength `ء ك ل:B012/m01`; intellectual substance `ء ك ل:B012/m02`; restraining intellect `ح ج ر:B002/m01`; weak opinion `ف ي ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Material density becomes a model for intellectual capacity, while laxity marks the contrasting failure to hold judgment firm.

subchannels.name: Stout Obstinacy and Outward Character
subchannels.scene_or_process: A compact bodily bearing expresses persistence that can appear as firmness or obstinacy.
subchannels.active_motifs: short stout build `ج ع ل:B012/m01`; obstinacy `ج ع ل:B012/m02`; visible character in action `ف ع ل:B002/m02`; outward appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Physique and conduct mirror one another, allowing compact form and repeated action to present an inwardly stubborn disposition.

subchannels.name: Awe as Arrested Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A commanding presence quiets movement and produces deliberate, composed stillness.
subchannels.active_motifs: birds stilled by awe `ط ي ر:B006/m01`; measured pacing `ر س ل:B004/m01`; dignified conduct `ف ع ل:B002/m02`; mutual facing `ر ء ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 105:1 تَرَ and فَعَلَ; 105:3 أَرْسَلَ and طَيْرًا
subchannels.synthesis: Awe is made visible through a reversal of motion: flight or impulsive movement stops, participants face one another, and composure takes over.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Inner capacity or character becomes legible through judgment, bodily form, controlled motion, and the response of others.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 105:1 تَرَ, فَعَلَ, and فِيلِ, together with 105:3 طَيْرًا, provide the lexical points of perception, conduct, weakness, and arrested movement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Character appears as material substance, weak opinion, stout obstinacy, visible bearing, deliberate pacing, and birds held still by awe.

parent_channels.name: S1. Emesis Against the Meal Container
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Ingested food moves from vessel to body and is then forcibly expelled.
parent_channels.active_motifs: vomiting `ك ي د:B007/m01`; eating `ء ك ل:B001/m01`; food vessel `ء ك ل:B013/m01`; date portion `ء ب ل:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Container, portion, ingestion, and reversal of ingestion form a complete bodily process centered on what cannot be retained.

parent_channels.name: S2. Command at Sea and Directed Travel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A shipmaster identifies a direction, displays a standard, and dispatches movement toward it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: master of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; directed dispatch `ر س ل:B001/m01`; travel toward a region `ر م ي:B007/m01`; visible standard `ر ء ي:B011/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Leadership, visible orientation, release, and directional travel make a compact navigation-and-command scene.

parent_channels.name: S3. Grammatical Placement and Argument Roles
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An utterance assigns participants and circumstances to governed grammatical positions.
parent_channels.active_motifs: grammatical objects and complements `ف ع ل:B007/m01`; governing particle `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; locative designation `ج ع ل:B011/m01`; attention-directing interrogative `ر ء ي:B013/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The utterance first calls attention, then places action, participant, relation, and location into a structured grammatical frame.

Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
